back: 'Must not be bypassed' is server-side — a plug-in. 'The user should see' is client script. Keyword: client script only runs with a form open.
Declarative, no code, form and optionally server. First choice for simple field validation and visibility. Keyword: try config first.
Surfaces external data as a Dataverse table with no copy and no sync. The answer when the external system stays system of record. Keyword: no duplication.
Backed by Cosmos DB for very high volume and sparse, semi-structured data. Trades relational features for scale. Keyword: telemetry, not master data.
Effective access is the union of every role held directly and via teams. Roles add, never subtract — there is no deny. Keyword: look for the extra role.
Combining connectors across business and non-business groups in one app or flow. It never inspects the data. Keyword: connector pairs, not content.
Grants access to an individual record outside the security role model entirely. Keyword: per record.
A connector invokes another service's operations. A table models data. Requirement phrased as an action means connector. Keyword: verb vs noun.
Unmanaged for development and editable. Managed for test and production, locked, and uninstallable cleanly. Keyword: managed leaves no trace.
Cannot be undone — components merge into the unmanaged layer and uninstalling removes nothing. Keyword: irreversible.
A change made directly in production overrides the managed solution and blocks future updates to that component. Keyword: remove the layer.
Definition travels with the solution; the value is set per environment. Keyword: same solution, different value.
Calling user context inherits their privileges and keeps row security honest. A service account escalates it. Keyword: deliberate escalation.
Can be reset and copied — the correct home for development. Production cannot be treated that way. Keyword: resettable.
Unpack a solution into component files so the repository history is diffable. One zip is a history nobody can review. Keyword: diffable.
Pipelines are in-product with approvals, for teams without DevOps. Build Tools expose the same operations as Azure Pipelines or GitHub tasks. Keyword: in-product vs DevOps.
Set makes a global variable across screens; UpdateContext makes a context variable scoped to one screen. Keyword: scope.
Updates specific columns of a record without replacing the whole record. Keyword: targeted write.
A delegable expression is evaluated by the data source. A non-delegable one pulls up to the limit and filters locally — silently wrong on large tables. Keyword: silently wrong.
500 rows by default, configurable to 2,000. Everything beyond it is invisible to a non-delegable formula. Keyword: 500 default.
Which functions delegate depends on the data source, so the same formula may delegate against one and not another. Keyword: source-dependent.
Library components are canvas-only and versioned. PCF code components work in canvas and model-driven. Keyword: PCF crosses both.
Shows every network call with timing for canvas and model-driven sessions. Turns 'feels slow' into a specific request. Keyword: measure first.
Blocks form rendering. Converting handlers to asynchronous where the logic allows is a direct win. Keyword: don't block load.
getAttribute reaches the data; getControl reaches the presentation of that data. Keyword: value vs control.
The checkbox that gives a handler formContext. Forgetting it is why a handler throws immediately. Keyword: tick the box.
Cancels the save from client script — but only protects the form, so a universal rule still needs a plug-in. Keyword: form only.
Performs Dataverse data operations from client script. Xrm.Navigation opens forms, dialogs, and custom pages. Keyword: data vs navigation.
init once, updateView on every data or context change, getOutputs to return values, destroy to clean up. Keyword: four methods.
Tells the platform to collect outputs. A component that never calls it appears to work and saves nothing. Keyword: silent failure.
Device, Web API, and utility features must be declared in the manifest before they are available at runtime. Keyword: declare to use.
Canvas-style screen inside a model-driven app, opened with Xrm.Navigation.navigateTo as page, dialog, or side pane. Keyword: replaces HTML web resources.
Before the database transaction and outside it — the cheap place to cancel an operation. Keyword: outside the transaction.
Inside the transaction, before the main operation. Modify the Target here to change what gets written. Keyword: change the values.
Inside the transaction, after the operation. Where work depending on the saved record belongs, including the generated id. Keyword: after the write.

front: Why you need a Pre Image
back: On Update the Target holds only changed columns, so any other value must come from an image. Keyword: Target is partial.
Sync runs in the transaction and can roll it back, but the user waits. Async runs afterwards and cannot affect the outcome. Keyword: can it cancel.
A new Dataverse message with typed parameters and a plug-in implementation, solution-aware and discoverable. Preferred over custom actions. Keyword: named operation.
Changes connector behaviour at runtime — headers, host, data type — without changing the underlying API. Keyword: adapt without touching the API.
Web API is OData REST for JavaScript and external callers. Organization service is the .NET SDK used in plug-ins. Keyword: caller decides.
A service principal that authenticates successfully still fails every request until an application user with a security role exists. Keyword: auth is not authorisation.
Enforced with HTTP 429 and Retry-After. Honour the header and back off; SDK clients do it automatically. Keyword: don't hammer.
$batch, ExecuteMultipleRequest, and CreateMultiple/UpdateMultiple — not from more parallel threads. Keyword: fewer round trips.
Runs a flow step when a previous one fails, combined with scopes for try-and-catch behaviour. Keyword: flow error handling.
Service Bus queues messages until the receiver collects them. A webhook needs the receiver available at the moment of the call. Keyword: can it be offline.
The endpoint for high-throughput telemetry-style streams rather than discrete business messages. Keyword: volume.
The platform waits for the response and a failure can affect the operation. Powerful and dangerous in equal measure. Keyword: blocks the save.
Returns only what changed since a token, including deletions — which a modified-since query cannot report. Keyword: deletes too.
A unique column combination acting as a business key, so external systems address rows without storing GUIDs. Keyword: their identifier.
Creates or updates in one request against an alternate key, removing the retrieve-then-decide race. Keyword: one call.
